## Reproduction and downloads

```bash
python scripts/run_multiclass.py --data-dir E:/Data/Jobs_2026_US
python scripts/verify_multiclass.py
python scripts/publish_multiclass.py
python scripts/publish_interactive.py
```

[Run manifest](data/multiclass/run.json) · [Class coverage](data/multiclass/class_support.csv) · [Model metrics](data/multiclass/metrics.csv) · [Per-sector metrics](data/multiclass/per_class.csv) · [Confusion counts](data/multiclass/confusion.csv)

Read the [executable source](scripts/run_multiclass.py), [complete code display](analysis_code.qmd), or [searchable aggregate tables](interactive.qmd). The [healthcare evaluation](career_evaluation.qmd) and [binary PySpark experiment](pyspark_analysis.qmd) remain separate analyses.
